# AutoScout24.com Scraper

<!-- This README is generated by .github/scripts/docs.py from the scraper code, its results/ folder and .github/scrapers.json: change those and run the script instead of editing it. -->

[![tests](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/raw/ci-status/badges/autoscout24-scraper.svg)](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/blob/ci-status/status/autoscout24-scraper.md)

Example scraper that collects car listings and car details from AutoScout24.com, written in Python with the [Scrapfly](https://scrapfly.io/) web scraping API. Part of [scrapfly-scrapers](../README.md).

- **Guide:** [How to Scrape AutoScout24 in 2026](https://scrapfly.io/blog/posts/how-to-scrape-autoscout24)
- **Code:** [`autoscout24.py`](autoscout24.py) · **Example run:** [`run.py`](run.py) · **Tests:** [`test.py`](test.py)
- **Sample output:** [Car details](results/car_details.json) · [Listings](results/listings.json)

## What it scrapes

- AutoScout24 car listings from search pages
- AutoScout24 car detail pages with specifications, features, and seller information

## Functions

- `scrape_listings(url, max_pages=3)` → `List[CarListing]`: Scrape car listings from AutoScout24 search/category page (with pagination)
- `scrape_car_details(urls)` → `List[CarDetails]`: Scrape detailed car information from car page

The functions are `async`: run them with `asyncio.run(...)` or `await` them.

### Example

The inputs are the examples of [`run.py`](run.py) (long lists cut short):

```python
import asyncio
import autoscout24


async def main():
    listings = await autoscout24.scrape_listings("https://www.autoscout24.com/lst/c/compact", max_pages=3)


asyncio.run(main())
```

## Output

The functions return plain dictionaries and lists. Fields:

- **`CarListing`**: `price`, `url`, `location?`, `vehicle?`, `tracking?`, `vehicleDetails?`
- **`CarDetails`**: `price`, `vehicle?`, `seller?`, `location?`

A field marked `?` can be `null`.

## Scrapfly settings

`BASE_CONFIG` in [`autoscout24.py`](autoscout24.py) holds the default settings of the requests, see the [Scrape API documentation](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/getting-started):

- `asp` = `True`: Anti Scraping Protection, the earlier name of the [Unblocker](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/unblocker)

## Quick start

Requires Python 3.10+ and [Poetry](https://python-poetry.org/docs/#installation).

```shell
git clone https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers.git
cd scrapfly-scrapers/autoscout24-scraper
export SCRAPFLY_KEY="YOUR SCRAPFLY KEY"   # from https://scrapfly.io/dashboard
poetry install --no-root
poetry run python run.py                  # example scrape, saves its output in ./results
poetry run pytest test.py                 # the tests of this scraper
```

Tests: `test_page_url`, `test_listings_scraping`, `test_car_details_scraping`; run one with `poetry run pytest test.py -k <test>`. `run.py` and the tests scrape the live website, so they use Scrapfly credits.
